items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the stalk of the left Kan extension of a presheaf along a functor at a point of the target is the stalk of the presheaf at the composite point (statement lines 8730-8738). The proof is a complete computation: the author rewrites the stalk as a colimit of colimits and combines them (proof lines 8741-8752); and the resulting comparison is justified by applying the companion result on colimits with connected fibres to an explicit functor between the index categories, whose hypotheses are verified by exhibiting a right inverse and checking that the fibre categories are connected (proof lines 8753-8771). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two colimit presentations. The claim is H2: a computation whose hypotheses are verified in the span.
